# Kemal Maulana

> Project Manager and Mobile Engineer based in Bandung, Indonesia. 8+ years shipping production mobile apps: native Android (Kotlin/Java) since 2018, Flutter since 2021. Currently Project Manager at Reacteev.id and Mobile Engineer for a government superapp in Kabupaten Bandung Barat.

## Facts
- Name: Kemal Maulana
- Location: Bandung, Indonesia
- Current roles: Project Manager at Reacteev.id (Mar 2025 – present); Mobile Engineer, Dinas Komunikasi, Informatika & Statistik Kab. Bandung Barat (Mar 2021 – present)
- Education: Bachelor of Informatics Engineering, Pasundan University (thesis: IoT and mobile)
- Expertise: Android, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, mobile architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture, BLoC), Agile/Scrum project management, IoT (Arduino, Raspberry Pi)
- Contact: kemalmaulana19@gmail.com
